“乃香嫂子，你胡说什么呢？”

“我只是进老林子打猎，又不是去送死的，而且我去老林子，也不仅仅只是为了还钱，我们家的情况你也是知道的，想要过上好日子，必须得想办法多赚钱。”

“我觉得打猎就很不错，而且我也是个人喜欢打猎。”

“还有，以后不要说嫁给李虎这种话了，否则今日我帮你的忙，岂不是白帮了？”

李青山开口道。

“唉！”

王乃香长叹一口气，脸上流露出一抹无奈之色，李青山铁了心想要进老林子，自己也劝不动。

当即。

从怀中掏出一个鸡蛋道：“青山，还是热乎的，赶紧吃了吧！！”

说罢，便朝着李青山递了过去。

鸡蛋刚刚从怀中掏出，还残存着乃香的余温，李青山伸手接过鸡蛋时，难免的接触到王乃香纤细的手指，一抹柔软传来，让李青山颇为受用，却也让王乃香急忙收回了手，霞飞双颊。

寡妇的心中小鹿乱撞，甚至有些不敢直视李青山的双眼。

旁边的稻草垛子散发出稻草的香味，夹杂着王乃香身上的体香，四周无人，这让李青山心中生出一股将王乃香压倒在旁边稻草垛子中的冲动。

“乃香嫂子，这若是让你公婆知道了，还不得打死你啊？”李青山接过鸡蛋，心中一跳道。

在这个年代，鸡蛋可是堪比肉的好东西啊。

平日里，普通庄户人家都舍不得吃，只有逢年过节，生病，或者生孩子的时候会吃。

王乃香在家里的地位本来就低贱。

就算是逢年过节都吃不上的，而且农村家中的鸡蛋都是有数的，少一个都能知晓。

家里少个鸡蛋。

赵贵两口子一定是第一时间怀疑王乃香。

到时候，少不得一阵毒打。

“无妨，反正已经煮熟了，不可能再放回去了。”

“青山，快吃了吧！”

“你不是要进老林子打猎吗？得多补充补充营养，才有力气去打猎不是？”

王乃香柔声柔气道。

若是前世，自己一定万般推辞，然后将鸡蛋塞回王乃香手中，让王乃香将鸡蛋吃了，转身离开，自认为王乃香着想。

其实，这是最差的一种处理方式。

女人给你送吃的，在你吃下去的那一刻，她才会获得成就感，才会开心。

在前世，这叫做情绪价值。

李青山也不再开启，将鸡蛋剥开咬了一半，土鸡蛋满口的浓香瞬间充斥味蕾，在前世想要吃到这种正宗的土鸡蛋，可不是一件容易的事情。

果然。

王乃香见到李青山一口吃掉了一半鸡蛋后，心中顿时升起了成就感，能够为李青山做些什么，王乃香很开心。

“乃香嫂子，咱们一人一半！”

说罢。

李青山将另外一半朝着王乃香嘴边递了过去。

“啊，这……不好吧！”

“鸡蛋本来就是给你们男人补充营养的，我一个女人吃了做什么。”

王乃香开口拒绝道。

“乃香嫂子，连半个鸡蛋你都不愿意吃，日后若是受了气，怎么可能会来麻烦我？”

“不许反驳！”

“来，张嘴！”

李青山说罢，便将手中的鸡蛋朝着乃香嫂子的嘴边递了过去。

“啊……！”

王乃香哪里和男人有过如此举动，刚刚啊出声，李青山的半个鸡蛋便已经塞到嘴边，只得乖巧听话的将尚且还有些余温的鸡蛋吞入口中。

细细嚼来，土鸡蛋的香味充斥味蕾。

半个土鸡蛋的余温，却也温暖了王乃香这颗破碎孤冷的心。

"Sister-in-law Naixiang, what are you talking about?"

"I just went to the old forest to hunt, not to die. And I went to the old forest not just to repay the money. You also know the situation of our family. If you want to live a good life, you must find a way to make more money."

"I think hunting is great, and I personally like hunting."

"Also, don't talk about marrying Li Hu in the future. Otherwise, wouldn't the help I helped you today be in vain?"

Li Qingshan said.

"Alas!"

Wang Naixiang let out a long sigh, with a look of helplessness on his face. Li Qingshan was determined to enter the old forest, but he couldn't persuade him.

Immediately.

He took out an egg from his arms and said: "Qingshan, it's still warm, eat it quickly!!"

After saying that, he handed it over to Li Qingshan.

The egg had just been taken out of his arms, still retaining the residual warmth of Naixiang. When Li Qingshan reached out to take the egg, he inevitably came into contact with Wang Naixiang's slender fingers. A touch of softness came to Li Qingshan, which greatly benefited Li Qingshan, but Wang Naixiang hurriedly retracted his hand, Xiafei's cheeks.

The widow's heart was racing, and she even dared not look directly into Li Qingshan's eyes.

The straw pile next to him exuded the fragrance of straw, mixed with Wang Naixiang's body fragrance. There was no one around, which gave Li Qingshan an urge to crush Wang Naixiang into the straw pile next to him.

"Sister-in-law Naixiang, if your parents-in-law find out about this, why don't they beat you to death?" Li Qingshan took the egg and said with a skip in his heart.

In this day and age, eggs are as good as meat.

On weekdays, ordinary farmers are reluctant to eat it, and they only eat it during festivals, illness, or when giving birth to children.

Wang Naixiang's status in the family is inherently low.

You can't even eat it during the holidays, and there are countless eggs in rural homes. You will know if there is one missing.

There are a few eggs at home.

Zhao Gui and his wife must have suspected Wang Naixiang immediately.

When the time comes, a beating will be inevitable.

"It doesn't matter, it's already cooked anyway and there's no way it can be put back."

"Qingshan, eat quickly!"

"Don't you want to go hunting in the old forest? You need to supplement your nutrition so that you have the strength to hunt, right?"

Wang Naixiang said in a soft voice.

If it were in the previous life, I would have refused in every possible way, then stuffed the egg back into Wang Naixiang's hand, let Wang Naixiang eat the egg, turned around and left, thinking that she was thinking of Wang Naixiang.

In fact, this is the worst way to handle it.

When a woman brings you food, she will feel a sense of accomplishment and be happy when you eat it.

In previous lives, this was called emotional value.

Li Qingshan stopped opening it, peeled the egg and bit into half of it. The strong aroma of the local eggs instantly filled his taste buds. It was not easy to eat such authentic local eggs in his previous life.

really.

After Wang Naixiang saw Li Qingshan eat half of the eggs in one bite, a sense of accomplishment suddenly arose in her heart. Wang Naixiang was very happy to be able to do something for Li Qingshan.

"Sister-in-law Naixiang, each of us has half!"

Say it.

Li Qingshan handed the other half towards Wang Naixiang's mouth.

"Ah, this...isn't good!"

"Eggs are meant to supplement nutrients for you men. What am I doing as a woman eating them?"

Wang Naixiang refused.

"Sister-in-law Naixiang, you are not willing to eat even half an egg. If you get angry in the future, how could you possibly trouble me?"

"No refutation allowed!"

"Come on, open your mouth!"

After Li Qingshan said this, he handed the egg in his hand towards Naixiang's sister-in-law's mouth.

"Ah...!"

Wang Naixiang had never behaved like this with a man before. Just as he made a sound, half of Li Qingshan's egg had already been stuffed into his mouth. He had to obediently swallow the still warm egg into his mouth.

Chew it carefully, and the aroma of free-range eggs fills your taste buds.

The remaining warmth of half a native egg also warmed Wang Naixiang's broken and lonely heart.
